title: Dulmál deployment diagram
description: How Dulmál runs: one Cloudflare Worker with static assets and a Durable Object class, one object per room, behind icelander.net's sign-in for holders of games:dulmal, with no database.

nodes.name: Player's phone or computer
nodes.description: Runs the page; one WebSocket to the room.

nodes.name: Shared big screen
nodes.description: A browser on a TV or projector opened with &skjar=1: the board, the clue and the score, never the key.

nodes.name: Cloudflare edge
nodes.description: Runs the Worker on icelander.net/games/dulmal*, ahead of the games hub's route.

nodes.name: dulmal Worker
nodes.description: worker/index.ts: the sign-in check on every request, the room API and the static page from ./dist.

nodes.name: RoomObject Durable Object
nodes.description: One per room code, with SQLite-backed storage holding the room as JSON and an alarm for the turn timer and idle deletion. Its WebSockets hibernate between messages.

nodes.name: icelander.net login service
nodes.description: accounts.icelander.net, in the icelander.net repository (accounts/): who holds the host's site_session cookie and their games: roles. The Worker reaches it only through a service binding.

artifacts.name: index.html, app.js, style.css, icon.svg and _headers
artifacts.description: Built by build.mjs into dist/games/dulmal/, with a strict Content-Security-Policy.

artifacts.name: Worker script
artifacts.description: The fetch handler and the RoomObject class, bundled by wrangler with data/ord.txt.

relationships.description: HTTPS for the page and to create a room; a WebSocket for the room.
The same page and WebSocket, as a screen.
Service binding ACCOUNTS (entrypoint Internal): every request needs a signed-in player with games:dulmal.
